name: Segment Sum
title: E. Segment Sum
legend:
You are given two integers l and r (l≤r). Your task is to calculate the sum of numbers from l to r (including l and r) such that each number contains at most k different digits, and print this sum modulo 998244353.

For example, if k=1 then you have to calculate all numbers from l to r such that each number is formed using only one digit. For l=10,r=50 the answer is 11+22+33+44=110.
input_spec: The only line of the input contains three integers l, r and k (1≤l≤r<1018,1≤k≤10) — the borders of the segment and the maximum number of different digits.
output_spec: Print one integer — the sum of numbers from l to r such that each number contains at most k different digits, modulo 998244353.
